runpod.verdict: BEST FOR STARTUP — cheapest GPU rental. No commitment. Start here before buying hardware.
runpod.pros: Cheapest. No minimum. Instant provisioning. Good for prototyping and burst workloads.
runpod.cons: GPU availability can vary. Queued during peak demand.

lambda.verdict: GOOD FOR TRAINING — NVIDIA-focused. Reserved instances available.
lambda.pros: NVIDIA partnership. Good for ML training clusters. Reserved pricing.
lambda.cons: No RTX 4090. Higher minimum than RunPod.

aws.verdict: ENTERPRISE ONLY — 3-5x RunPod prices. Use only if already on AWS with credits.
aws.pros: Massive ecosystem (S3, Lambda, SageMaker). Enterprise compliance. Global regions.
aws.cons: EXPENSIVE. Complex pricing. Egress fees. GPU availability limited.

gcp.verdict: GOOD FOR SPOT — 90% off with spot instances. Cheapest H100 if you handle preemption.
gcp.pros: TPU unique. Spot instances up to 90% off. Best storage pricing ($0.04/GB).
gcp.cons: Spot instances can terminate any time. GPU availability varies by region.
